summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 of cipher-box to implement writable shares PoC — allowing share recipients to upload, edit, rename, and delete files in shared folders with proper per-file IPNS records and dual-key wrapping.
summary.outcome: Phase 27 fully shipped: 3 plans executed, 8 security issues fixed (TDD), 23 PR review threads resolved across 4 rounds, 21 E2E tests and 217 backend unit tests passing, branch pushed and PR #372 open.

repo: cipher-box-ci-debug is a separate checkout from cipher-box — .env files don't exist there and must be copied from the main repo (cipher-box/apps/api/.env etc.) when switching to the debug branch
Web dev server defaults to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL is unset, resolving to localhost:5173/api instead of localhost:3000 — always set VITE_API_URL in apps/web/.env
SDK, sdk-core, and core packages must be built in dependency order before the web dev server will start in cipher-box-ci-debug
OTPs for test login are logged to the API console and can be retrieved with: grep -a 'Your OTP' <api-log>
Orval generates an object type (not string) for nullable string fields in OpenAPI — known orval limitation; consumer code must handle this manually
openapi.json must end with a trailing newline or the CI api-client diff check fails
The GSD workflow system uses .planning/security/ for security review reports and supports TDD red/green verification of fixes
SharesService was added as a dependency of IpnsService during phase 27 — ipns.service.spec.ts needs a mockSharesService provider added to its test module
The withConflictRetry pattern captures React state in closures — all callers must use refs alongside setState to avoid stale data after navigation or concurrent operations
reWrapForRecipients must be called after every owner file content update (handleUpdateFile) to propagate new file keys to share_keys entries

code.finding: Shared upload previously set fileMetaIpnsName: '' — skipped per-file IPNS record creation. Fixed by inlining generateFileIpnsKeypair and wrapping with owner key (FilePointer) + recipient key (share_keys with keyType 'file-ipns')

Checks item.fileMetaIpnsName which is '' for files uploaded via shared folders — needed a separate onSaveSharedFile callback prop wired through SharedFileBrowser to bypass the owner-only updateFile path

withConflictRetry closures for upload/mkdir/rename/delete captured stale React state. Fix: maintain folderChildrenRef and sequenceNumberRef synced alongside setState calls, and sync refs in all navigation functions (navigateToSubfolder, navigateUp, navigateToBreadcrumb)
handleUpdateFile did not re-wrap new file key for share recipients after owner edits. Fixed by calling reWrapForRecipients after every file content update, same as post-upload flow

createShare did not validate the permission/IPNS-key invariant — write shares without encryptedIpnsKey or read shares with one could be created. Added explicit guard: write requires encryptedIpnsKey, read forbids it
Permission downgrade (clearing encryptedIpnsKey + deleting file-ipns share_keys) must be wrapped in a transaction to prevent partial state on failure
ECIES ciphertext MinLength was set to 2 (too permissive) — changed to 64. Also added even-length hex @Matches validation to all encryptedKey fields in create-share.dto.ts and share-key.dto.ts

FolderIpns lookup for write-share publish authorization must use the sharer's userId (from share record), not the calling recipient's userId — otherwise owner can't update their own files after recipient uploads

upgradingId state gets stuck if handleUpgrade returns early (e.g. confirmation declined). Fixed with try/finally to always clear upgradingId/downgradingId. Also added unified isRowBusy(shareId) check so upgrade/downgrade/revoke buttons are all disabled while any action is in-flight for that row

workflow: TDD for security fixes: stash fixes, write failing tests (red), restore fixes, verify green — makes security regression coverage explicit
Background Bash tasks in Claude Code get killed when the conversation shifts — use nohup/setsid detached processes for dev servers that need to persist
When CI reports 'api client needs regeneration', check if openapi.json has a trailing newline — the diff check treats missing newline as a change
After adding a new service dependency to a NestJS module, update the corresponding .spec.ts test module providers or DI resolution will fail in CI even if local tests pass
Resolve PR threads via GitHub GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation; reply first via REST (in_reply_to must be integer, use --field not -f)
Security review skill generates .planning/security/REVIEW-*.md with severity-classified findings and implementable test case suggestions — useful for catching crypto invariant violations before merge

friction: Dev servers in cipher-box-ci-debug repeatedly killed by background task cleanup — required 4+ restart attempts before switching to detached nohup processes
DB host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) with no .env in the debug checkout — required creating .env from scratch then replacing with full copy from main repo
Web app connected to wrong API URL (localhost:5173/api) until VITE_API_URL explicitly set — not obvious from UI error message
git lock file blocked commits during the security fix phase — had to manually remove .git/index.lock
GitHub GraphQL API timed out multiple times when fetching review threads — required retries
Orval generates object type for nullable strings — the encryptedIpnsKey field in ReceivedShareResponseDto generates as a union object instead of string | null, requiring manual handling in consumers
CI caught unused ForbiddenException import left behind when a test was removed — minor but required a fix commit
Missing trailing newline in openapi.json caused spurious CI diff failure requiring another fix commit
ipns.service.spec.ts DI failure only appeared in CI (not local tests) because local test runner cached the module — required adding mockSharesService to test module providers
open_items: reWrap file-ipns keys when owner edits a file — currently owner edits don't update the recipient's file-ipns share_key entry, only the file key share_key (marked not applicable/by design for PoC but noted as future work)
Single-share polling endpoint — polling currently fetches all received shares every 30s; a targeted endpoint would reduce load (deferred as scope creep for PoC)
100-share limit in polling — fetchReceivedShares is implicitly limited; no pagination (accepted PoC limitation)
Orval nullable string codegen bug — ReceivedShareResponseDtoEncryptedIpnsKey generates as object union instead of string | null; needs orval config override or upstream fix
reWrap share keys before IPNS publish in shared uploads (pre-existing pattern from owner upload flow — not addressed in PoC scope)
E2E tests have transient Web3Auth Core Kit init failures that cause test suite retries — root cause not investigated
